digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions mirror CI for main branch
propositions: cancelled runs on the GitHub mirror main branch render as red X despite a healthy codebase because concurrency collapses superseded pushes
option 3 moves all main health CI to scheduled 6-hourly triggers (minutes 41/47/53) with workflow_dispatch fallback, eliminating per-commit cancellations
the main-health-report job resolves the last-known-green SHA from Actions API history and publishes a copy-pasteable git bisect start command to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY for remediation

push triggers are removed from main (test.yml optionality.yml verify-identity.yml prompt-eval.yml via branches-ignore; codeql.yml terraform-drift.yml via push key deletion) while non-main branch push CI and all untouchable workflows remain unchanged
pre-merge Gerrit Verified gating is unaffected because gerrit-verify.yaml and the four _*.yml reusables are not modified and remain the real merge gate
